# resend Provider



## Example Usage

```terraform
# The provider reads RESEND_API_KEY from the environment if api_key is not set
# in this block. The config value, when present, takes precedence.
provider "resend" {
  # api_key = var.resend_api_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) A Resend API key. May also be supplied via the `RESEND_API_KEY` environment variable; the config value takes precedence when both are set.
